meta.title: Moddy Max
meta.description: Moddy Max unlocks full bot customization and faster social notifications on up to 5 of your Discord servers.

hero.title: Make Moddy yours
hero.description: Full bot customization and faster social notifications, on up to 5 of your servers.

features.customization: Custom nickname, avatar, banner and bio
features.notifications: Faster social notifications, 5 accounts per platform

success.title: Thanks for subscribing to Moddy Max!
success.description: Now <link>choose which servers get premium</link> from your dashboard.

cancel.title: Checkout cancelled
cancel.description: You haven’t been charged. Come back whenever you’re ready.

blocked.title: This account can’t subscribe
blocked.description: Your account is restricted and can’t start a Moddy Max subscription. If you think this is a mistake, <link>contact support</link>.

error.title: Checkout couldn’t start
error.description: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

perks.title: What’s included
perks.description: A focused set of extras. Everything else works the same on every server.

servers.title: 5 premium servers
servers.description: Activate Moddy Max on up to 5 servers of your choice. Switch which servers have premium at any time from your dashboard.

customization.title: Full bot customization
customization.description: Change Moddy’s nickname, avatar, banner and bio on your server, and make the bot feel native to your community’s brand.

notifications.title: Faster social notifications
notifications.description: Faster polling on YouTube, Twitch and RSS (Bluesky is already realtime for everyone), plus up to 5 accounts per platform instead of 1.

comparison.title: Free vs Moddy Max
comparison.description: Moddy Max is intentionally narrow: it enhances bot customization and social notifications. Everything else runs identically on every server, free or premium.
comparison.caption: Features of the free plan and of Moddy Max

activation.title: Premium in five steps
activation.description: Subscribe once, then pick your servers from the dashboard. No restart or re-invite required.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to Moddy Max
subscribe.description: Choose a <plans>monthly or yearly plan</plans> and complete checkout.

dashboard.title: Open the dashboard
dashboard.description: Go to <dashboard>dashboard.moddy.app</dashboard> and sign in with your Discord account.

premiumServers.title: Click Premium Servers
premiumServers.description: This is where you manage which servers receive premium features.

select.title: Select your servers
select.description: Choose up to 5 servers where Moddy is installed. You can change your selection at any time.

save.title: Save your selection
save.description: Premium is active on your selected servers immediately.

note.title: Tied to your Discord account
note.description: A server stays premium as long as at least one subscriber who selected it has an active subscription. Use /subscription in Discord to check your plan and renewal date.
